mapper.select: SELECT MAX(AM.QRY_ROL_YN) AS QRY_ROL_YN, MAX(AM.REG_ROL_YN) AS REG_ROL_YN, MAX(AM.UPD_ROL_YN) AS UPD_ROL_YN, MAX(AM.DEL_ROL_YN) AS DEL_ROL_YN, MAX(AM.EXE_ROL_YN) AS EXE_ROL_YN FROM TB_SCR_AUTH_MENU AM JOIN TB_SCR_MENU M ON M.MENU_ID = AM.MENU_ID WHERE M.MENU_PATH = #{menuPath} AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND AM.AUTH = #{auth} AND AM.USE_YN = 'Y'
